title: Boot loads live-projection sessions eagerly and terminal session history lazily
outcome: Boot no longer loads every persisted session with its tails (src/persist_sqlite_transcript_read.rs:14-75) before serving; live-projection members load eagerly and terminal history loads on demand from the archive index, so boot time and memory are bounded by live membership, with no durable change.
acceptance: A boot over a store with more than N terminal sessions serves /api/state before any terminal session's transcript tail is read, proven by a test with an instrumented reader.

Every archive and per-id history read after boot returns the same content as before this change, covered by tests on a real temporary SQLite store with roots, live children, terminal children and dangling links.
The measured boot duration and resident memory before and after are recorded on the item; the full gate passes on the exact committed tree with a clean independent review pair.
